description: Render the project to MP4 in the user’s editor, save it to their library and return a share link. Takes about as long as the video, so this returns a job id at once: poll get_job. The plan’s limits apply (Free: 720p with a watermark, videos up to 10 minutes, 10 exports a month; Starter 1080p; Pro and Business 4K).

project.description: Project id from list_projects or create_project

share.description: Also make a public watch link (default true)

name: export_video
title: Export the finished video
